reviewer: Codex, independent; did not author v2, v3, v4, v5, or v6
reviewScope: Independent design-contract review only. This review does not mark DR-103 SATISFIED, does not qualify or demonstrate anything, and does not authorize implementation.
summary: All named v5 repair attacks pass, but v6 carries a stale empirical assertion that no fixture exists. A separate digest-pinned fixture-corpus candidate now exists with all 64 declared authored/supporting paths present. That candidate is not accepted or qualifying evidence, so DR-103 remains unsatisfied, but the literal v6 statement must be corrected.

shouldFix.title: The non-qualification clause falsely says no fixture exists yet
shouldFix.detail: whatThisDoesNotDo[1] says that the test-corpus section states requirements for future retained evidence 'and no fixture exists yet.' The separate component-manifest-fixture-corpus.v1 candidate exists at sha256 d81a4ef9ed26405a07e84ae0be9a3d2048fd9a6126b1f93d139a5a499204b542, declares 51 authored files and 13 supporting-byte files, and all 64 declared paths exist. Its status is CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED / AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW / binds NOTHING, so its existence does not qualify anything and does not satisfy DR-103; nevertheless, 'no fixture exists' is now factually false. The correct boundary is that v6 itself authors no fixtures and no fixture corpus is accepted or qualified here.
evidence: docs/v2/architecture/08-decision-and-readiness-register.md DR-103 row (still OPEN; corpus half not SATISFIED)
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Replace the existence claim with a non-authorizing statement such as: 'this artifact authors no fixtures; the separate fixture-corpus candidate is not accepted, qualified, or applied here.' Do not change DR-103 status or authorize implementation.

advisories.title: Define a total tuple comparator before lock production is enabled
advisories.detail: The future ordering rule now carries the correct key fields, but 'sorted by (stableId, version, scope)' does not state canonical representations or comparison order. In particular, semantic-version precedence does not distinguish build metadata. No lock is currently producible, so this is not a present blocker; before DR-111 enables lock production, the owning closure should define a total ordering or an exact-byte tie-breaker.
